description: JavaScript code for handling browser alerts and notifications within SuiteCRM, including alert object definitions, permission requests, display logic, and alert management functions.

classes.name: AlertObj
classes.description: Object representing an alert with title and options.

classes.name: Alerts
classes.description: Prototype object managing alert notifications, permissions, display, and updates.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Requests notification permission and updates alert title based on permission status.

methods.name: requestPermission
methods.description: Requests browser notification permission if supported.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a notification alert, with fallback confirmation dialog if notifications are not granted.

methods.name: addToManager
methods.description: Adds an alert to the alert manager, posts data to server, and updates the alert display.

methods.name: redirectToLogin
methods.description: Redirects to login page if session is lost.

methods.name: updateManager
methods.description: Fetches and updates alert notifications, manages alert UI state.

methods.name: markAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific alert as read and updates the alert list.
